Sweet, tart wildberries are folded into thin, springy dough to make this dessert.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Wildberry Crepes can be made by [[Cooking]] a [[Wildberry]], [[Fresh Milk]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], and a [[Bird Egg]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. By eating them, some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s will be restored to his [[Life Gauge]]. The Wildberries in this [[Meal]] are noted to be sweet and tart, while the dough is thin and springy. Since Wildberry Crepes require five ingredients to be made, all of which lack any [[Added Effect]]s, no variations can be made. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Wildberry Crepes have the same [[Recipe]] that they did in {{BotW}}, which involves [[Link]] [[Cooking]] a [[Wildberry]] with a bottle of [[Fresh Milk]], [[Cane Sugar]], a bundle of [[Tabantha Wheat]], and a [[Bird Egg]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Wildberry Crepes is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Extreme Foraging]]". It is made using two [[Wildberry|Wildberries]], two [[Bird Egg]]s, two bundles of [[Tabantha Wheat]], two bottles of [[Fresh Milk]], and two pieces of [[Cane Sugar]]. However, this can be lowered to one of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], [[Enemy|Enemies]] will have a 20% higher chance of dropping [[Material]]s upon their defeat. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Wildberry Crepe Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for a Wildberry Crepe ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Honey Crepe * Meal * Plain Crepe }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Health Restoring Items, Food, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
